identity.name: Actuarial Science Association
identity.tagline: Shaping the Future of Actuarial Science

relationship.faculty: Faculty of Science - Department of Mathematics

overview: The Actuarial Science Association of the University of Dar es Salaam (ASAUD) is a student-led organization dedicated to supporting students pursuing actuarial science. We bridge the gap between academic learning and professional practice through resources, mentorship, and industry connections.
vision: To be a leading student association that advances actuarial science education and professional development in East Africa.
mission: To support actuarial science students through academic resources, professional guidance, and community engagement while promoting excellence in the field.

objectives.title: Academic Excellence
objectives.description: Provide quality academic support and resources to help students succeed in their studies.

objectives.title: Career Development
objectives.description: Facilitate career development through mentorship, networking, and industry exposure.

objectives.title: Professional Awareness
objectives.description: Promote awareness of actuarial science as a profession across East Africa.

objectives.title: Community Building
objectives.description: Foster a vibrant, inclusive, and supportive student community.

objectives.title: Industry Partnerships
objectives.description: Collaborate with industry partners and professional bodies for mutual benefit.

objectives.title: Research & Innovation
objectives.description: Encourage research, data analysis, and innovative problem-solving among students.

coreValues.description: Striving for the highest standards in all our activities.
Operating with honesty and strong moral principles.
Building strong relationships and supporting one another.
Embracing new ideas and continuous improvement.
Welcoming students from all backgrounds and experiences.
Upholding the standards of the actuarial profession.

membershipScope.title: Who Can Join
membershipScope.description: ASAUD membership is open to all students currently enrolled in the Actuarial Science programme at the University of Dar es Salaam.

categories.name: Full Members
categories.description: Actively enrolled Actuarial Science students at UDSM.
categories.eligibility: Currently registered in the Actuarial Science programme

categories.name: Associate Members
categories.description: Students from related fields (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science).
categories.eligibility: Enrolled in related programmes with interest in actuarial science

categories.name: Alumni Members
categories.description: Graduates of the Actuarial Science programme at UDSM.
categories.eligibility: Completed the Actuarial Science degree at UDSM

roles.description: Providing study materials, tutorials, and academic guidance to members.
Connecting students with professionals, internships, and job opportunities.
Organizing social events and fostering a supportive student community.
Promoting actuarial science as a profession within and beyond UDSM.
